lesson: Task reference form, measured over chain, fan-in and diamond plans. A $task reference is an OBJECT placed exactly where the value belongs: {"$task":"join","path":"/value"}. Never write a reference as a quoted string and never JSON-encode it; the supervisor rejects a stringified reference with INVALID_REFERENCE. An array may contain literal strings and references together and is NOT required to be type-homogeneous, so ["label:", {"$task":"read","path":"/text"}] is correct. A reference WITHOUT path resolves to that task entire result object, so where a string or number is required name the key with a path: text.concat returns {"value":...} so use /value, files.read returns the file body under text so use /text. Each tool outputKeys lists the keys its result always has.
